**Stop.** If this is a vulnerability, credential leak, or hostile-input escape, do **not** continue here.

Report privately using `SECURITY.md`:

- GitHub Security Advisory: https://github.com/trippyogi/gitworthy/security/advisories/new

If this is a non-security product bug, close this issue and open a Bug report instead.
